'''Mnemotherapy''' (also known as vein routing) was a [[Force power/Legends|Force technique]] used primarily by the [[Theran Listener]]s to visualize the target's memories and eradicate them. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was taught Mnemotherapy, and used a powerful version of it to free [[Callista Ming]] from [[Abeloth]].
